verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows API version identifiers (such as versioned paths or headers), versioning guarantees, or a documented deprecation policy with timelines for Coinbase Payments/CDP. The only related item is a migration guide from the Commerce Charge API to the Checkouts API (docs-9). That is a single product-migration path, not a versioning scheme or deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
